_about: Opponent ladder (lane V66HUD), read by GameLoop.cs. 'Next opponent' after a victory moves one row down; Retry stays on the row. A row multiplies the scene's Pitborn (the baked difficulty-7 values): hpMul on max health, damageMul on every blow he lands (DuelFighter.damageScale), difficulty = a row id of difficulty.json whose nine AI knobs replace his brain profile (0 = keep the scene's brain). Past the last row the last row repeats and endlessHpStep / endlessDamageStep are added per extra fight. enabled=false = every fight is the scene as built. Applied applyAfterFrames frames after the scene loads (after fight_balance.json).
